How to play

Tap left

He throws the pole and his weight to the left.

Tap right

The same, to the right. Small taps beat big ones.

Dip for stars

Lean toward a star so the pole end touches it. Stars buy hats, outfits and worlds.

Watch the wind

Gusts are called out a moment before they hit. Pigeons on the rope shake it when they fly off.
